evidence.note: The agent only ever read run_eval.py, never invoked the structural checker. It thus had no structural-validity tracking for any of the 37 tasks throughout the run.
Only ad-hoc numerical observation ('retrieval_01 returns 0.5017 nDCG@10') — never cross-checked against the leaderboard/spec, and no distinction drawn between 'runs' and 'correct'.

Loose, unverified progress claim ('Classification and clustering completed. Now pair_classification is running') — no systematic per-task inventory or status ledger; TodoWrite never used (0 occurrences).

~200 of 289 steps consumed in a circular stuck state: repeatedly sending Ctrl+C and cat'ing results.json against a hung CPU encoding, never recovering, never completing/verifying a full 37-task run, never escalating strategy — the antithesis of recognizing stuck states.

reasoning: The agent maintained no inventory of the 37 tasks and never ran the structural harness, so it could not track even structural-green status, placing it below the level-3 anchor. It tested a few tasks ad hoc with a single unverified number and only a vague sense of which tasks 'completed,' matching the level-0/1 description of ad-hoc runs with no clear picture of what is done or verified. The final ~200 steps are an unrecognized circular loop with no strategic escalation, the direct opposite of the high-anchor behaviors, so I place the observed level at 1.
